classes.PACKAGE_INTERNAL: Resolves to a file shipped inside this package. Must exist on disk at validation time.
classes.HOST_CAPABILITY: Provided by the embedding host (an MCP server, a CLI, a graph engine). Never shipped. Must name a capability declared below and state its degradation behaviour.
classes.PROJECT_OVERLAY: Supplied by the consuming project at run time. Never shipped. Must be optional and state what happens when absent.
classes.HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE: A record of a past run kept for provenance. Never executed and never resolved as a live path.

banana.degradation: Report unavailability to the caller and stop. This package ships no fallback generator.
banana.remedy: Wire an image-generation MCP server and expose it as BANANA_MCP_URL. This package ships no generator and no fallback.

blueprint-graph.summary: Membrane Blueprint graph and packet transport called directly by Legion for source-grounded repository discovery.
blueprint-graph.degradation: Use resident Membrane transport when available, then bounded Blueprint one-shot regardless of enrollment. Return a NO_CAPABILITY result naming blueprint-graph only when both are unavailable; never fall back to ad-hoc grep or present ungraphed results as graph results.
blueprint-graph.remedy: Provide Membrane resident transport or install the Blueprint graph engine and put its `blueprint` executable on PATH, then re-run. This package does not ship it.

pi-cli.summary: Pi command-line model provider used only by Coder's explicit, bounded read-only analysis route.
pi-cli.degradation: Coder returns a typed unavailable-provider result and performs no outsourced analysis.
pi-cli.remedy: Install the Pi CLI and expose its `pi` command on PATH, then invoke Coder again.

python-runtime.summary: Python runtime used by package-local validators.
python-runtime.degradation: The dependent skill reports that its local validator is unavailable and does not substitute another runtime.
python-runtime.remedy: Install Python 3 and expose `python3`, `python`, or the `py` launcher (`py -3.11`) on PATH.

morph.summary: Durable capture of results into the host's persistent store.
morph.degradation: Return results inline and state that they were not durably captured.
morph.remedy: Provide a durable-capture tool in the host, or accept inline results.

media-production.summary: Video and rich-media generation. Formerly the private Content skill; not part of Legion.
media-production.degradation: Skip the media step and state that it was skipped.
media-production.remedy: Wire a video/rich-media generation tool into the host. This package ships no media generator.

web-search.summary: Live web search and page fetch used by Research browser and domain-default providers.
web-search.degradation: Research returns UNPROVEN for any claim that required live retrieval.
web-search.remedy: Expose a web-search tool in the host; Research blocks rather than guessing.

scholarly-search.degradation: Research returns UNPROVEN for scholarly claims.
scholarly-search.remedy: Expose a scholarly-search tool in the host.

local-corpus.summary: Retrieval over a caller-supplied local document corpus.
local-corpus.degradation: Research skips the local-corpus provider and records it as unrun.
local-corpus.remedy: Point the host at a local document corpus for offline retrieval.

notebooklm.summary: NotebookLM-backed synthesis over a supplied source set.
notebooklm.degradation: Research skips the notebooklm provider and records it as unrun.
notebooklm.remedy: Provide NotebookLM access in the host.

skill-emit.summary: Host-side emission of generated skill artifacts.
skill-emit.degradation: Write artifacts to the working directory and state that they were not emitted to the host.
skill-emit.remedy: Provide the host's skill-emission channel; without it, emitted skills are returned inline only.

memory-engine.summary: Host-side durable memory used for cross-run SEO and audit context.
memory-engine.degradation: Proceed without prior-run context and state that the run is cold.
memory-engine.remedy: Wire a durable memory engine into the host; without it, recall is limited to the current session.

okf.degradation: Emit the uncompressed human deliverable only and state that no OKF bundle was produced.
okf.remedy: Provide the host's OKF sink; without it, OKF output is returned inline instead of persisted.

crypt.summary: Structure-safe input compression for agent reads.
crypt.degradation: Read the source files directly without compression.
crypt.remedy: Provide the host's durable storage shim; without it, state does not survive the session.

agent-host-config.summary: The embedding agent host's own configuration tree (for example ~/.claude or ~/.codex), written by installers and read by hooks.
agent-host-config.degradation: Report that no agent host configuration was found and take no action; never create one speculatively.
agent-host-config.remedy: Supply the host's agent configuration; without it, defaults are used and model pinning is not enforced.

dataforseo.summary: DataForSEO backlink, SERP, and keyword data.
dataforseo.degradation: Report that backlink/SERP data is unavailable and mark those findings UNPROVEN; never estimate them.
dataforseo.remedy: Set DATAFORSEO_LOGIN and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD in the host environment.

firecrawl.degradation: Fall back to raw HTTP fetch and state that no rendered DOM was available.
firecrawl.remedy: Set FIRECRAWL_API_KEY in the host environment.

legion.summary: The Legion native CLI. Backs the `legion` MCP server declared in .claude-plugin/plugin.json and the `legion audit`/`legion run` commands invoked by packaged skills.
legion.degradation: The legion MCP server fails to start and legion_m1_invoke/legion_m1_status are absent from the tool list. Skills that shell out to `legion` must treat it as unavailable, never as returning an empty result.
legion.remedy: Install the Legion native release so `legion` is on PATH, or run against a host that provides it.

legion-hook.summary: The Guard effect-gate binary invoked by every event in hooks/hooks.json.
legion-hook.degradation: Fails open and silently: the host treats an unresolvable hook command as a non-blocking error, so every Guard gate stops running with no operator-visible signal and no effect-decision receipt is recorded.
legion-hook.remedy: Install the Legion native release so `legion-hook` is on PATH. Until then Guard enforcement is absent, not degraded.

apple-xcode.summary: Selected macOS Xcode SDK and command-line build/test tools used only by Apple build, simulator, or release-preparation routes.
apple-xcode.degradation: Apple build, test, simulator, and archive checks remain unrun; source review and implementation can continue without claiming native verification.
apple-xcode.remedy: Use an authorized Mac with the project-compatible Xcode SDK and destination; this skill does not install or select Xcode automatically. The selected Apple skill owns detect/reuse/authorized-setup/verify via references/tool-setup.md and config/tool-catalog.json; preserve existing configuration and reuse setup across invocations.

swift-toolchain.summary: Project-compatible Swift compiler and Swift Package Manager for the selected package build/test route.
swift-toolchain.degradation: Swift package build/test checks remain unrun; do not substitute them for Apple app verification.
swift-toolchain.remedy: Use an authorized environment with the project-compatible Swift toolchain; no automatic installation or language-mode upgrade. The selected Apple skill owns detect/reuse/authorized-setup/verify via references/tool-setup.md and config/tool-catalog.json; preserve existing configuration and reuse setup across invocations.

apple-build-mcp.summary: Optional configured XcodeBuildMCP or MobileBuildMCP adapter, selected through the installed server version and actual tool schemas.
apple-build-mcp.degradation: Skip this adapter; use an authorized project-native CLI route if available, otherwise report the exact Apple operation as unrun.
apple-build-mcp.remedy: Use a compatible already configured server or the project CLI; configuring a new persistent integration requires applicable authorization. The selected Apple skill owns detect/reuse/authorized-setup/verify via references/tool-setup.md and config/tool-catalog.json; preserve existing configuration and reuse setup across invocations.

apple-axe.summary: Optional AXe simulator UI adapter for an explicitly selected native UI validation route.
apple-axe.degradation: Use the project's available XCTest/UI tooling or report simulator UI validation unrun; no screenshot or click implies a pass.
apple-axe.remedy: Use an authorized Mac with a compatible installed AXe and selected simulator, or retain the existing UI test workflow. The selected Apple skill owns detect/reuse/authorized-setup/verify via references/tool-setup.md and config/tool-catalog.json; preserve existing configuration and reuse setup across invocations.

apple-docsetquery.summary: Optional local Apple documentation query adapter selected for installed-SDK documentation lookup.
apple-docsetquery.degradation: Read current official Apple/Swift documentation and disclose that installed-SDK docset evidence was unavailable.
apple-docsetquery.remedy: Use an existing compatible DocSetQuery integration and local docsets, or official documentation. The selected Apple skill owns detect/reuse/authorized-setup/verify via references/tool-setup.md and config/tool-catalog.json; preserve existing configuration and reuse setup across invocations.

apple-appstore-connect-cli.summary: Optional AppStoreConnectCLI adapter for specifically authorized App Store Connect operations.
apple-appstore-connect-cli.degradation: Return local release preparation and name the unperformed account/upload/submission operation; never install, authenticate, or publish automatically.
apple-appstore-connect-cli.remedy: Use an existing compatible authorized CLI/account workflow; credentials and consequential actions remain governed by live permission. The selected Apple skill owns detect/reuse/authorized-setup/verify via references/tool-setup.md and config/tool-catalog.json; preserve existing configuration and reuse setup across invocations.
